Play Dead was an ability granted to Feral Druids when they cast Symbiosis on a Hunter. It was a version of the Hunter ability Feign Death.
A Pledge of Adoration: Undercity is a container item obtained from (guard) NPCs in Undercity during the Love is in the Air seasonal event.

A Pledge of Loyalty: Undercity is a pledge gift given out by NPCs during the Love is in the Air seasonal event. These are combined into packages which are in turn hierarchically combined with other pledge packages for buffs and rewards. All of the Love is in the Air pledge gifts are non-functional as regards their name and picture. You cannot read a Pledge of Loyalty: Undercity. __NOTOC__
Plate and Mail Protection is a shop found in the Bazaar of Silvermoon City. It shares space with Shields of Silver.
A Pledge of Friendship: Undercity is a container item obtained from (guard) NPCs in Undercity during the Love is in the Air seasonal event. __NOTOC__

Pleasure-Bot 8000 is a clockwork giant initially located on Duskfall Island in Talador. It was originally created by Torben Zapblast/Ziz Fizziks (depending on your faction) to gather " truffles" but broke after it swam through a lake, shorting its power fluctuator. After Torben/Ziz asks the adventurer to gather sacs from electric eels in the nearby lake, the robot comes alive but rejects its creator. It instead calls the adventurer its "owner" and offers its services as a follower. The bot can be seen watching fights between garrison commanders in the Coliseum of Highmaul.

Due to poaching in Terokkar Forest, Terokkar basilisks don't tend to live very long. The Alliance poached Horde dire wolves in the Jagged Ridge of the Blade's Edge Mountains. Mogu spiritclaws in the Jade Forest resorted to poaching. Slitherscale saurok poachers were stealing the eggs of cloud serpents in the Jade Forest. Several poachers attacked the bear Grimclaw in Darkshore. During the third invasion of the Burning Legion, class order champions hunted Feltotem Highmountain tauren poachers. Plushie Rush is an ability used by the Elekk Plushie during a pet battle. Even though it doesn't do any damage, it will remove enemy shielding buffs such as Bubble (pet battle ability).
Poison Barrels are found at the Shattered Rise in Spires of Arak. They also drop from Shattered Hand Brewers.

.]] Polymorph is a mage ability, learned at level 10 or from the Exile's Reach quest A Mage's Knowledge. This ability offers long-duration crowd control that breaks on damage.

Shamans have interpreted wall paintings in a network of caves outside of Thunder Bluff, paintings that speak of the ancient tauren artifact called the Por-ah Stone. The paintings suggest the stone can be used to communicate with the elder tauren of days before the Sundering. Many chieftains have argued whether they should search out the Por-ah Stone. Some say the elders could use the Stone to guide tauren better in the old ways, restoring the tribes to their former glory. Others proclaim it to be the work of arcane magic — which might therefore destroy the tribes. With no tribal decision made yet, the Por-ah Stone remains undiscovered. Whatever its true function, it would likely fetch a high

The Portal to The Purple Parlor is a portal in the Violet Citadel of Dalaran (Northrend version) just up the main stairs from the entrance and to the right (opposite the portal to the Caverns of Time). It teleports to the Purple Parlor in the upper-level tower of the Violet Citadel. To get back down, the Portal to The Violet Citadel may be used. There is no such portal in the Broken Isles version of Dalaran, so the Purple Parlor can only be accessed by flying there.

Poor Communication is an achievement earned from burning Sargerei Missives in Shattrath City, Talador. The missives are found in the city center, and in the inside and outside of buildings in the residential areas. They can only be burned during Assault on the Heart of Shattrath.
Portal: Shattrath is a mage ability that opens a portal for the mage's group to the Terrace of Light in Shattrath City.
Portal: Stormwind is an Alliance-only mage ability that opens a portal for the mage's group to the Wizard's Sanctum in Stormwind City for the mage's group.

Portal: Darnassus is an Alliance-only mage ability that opens a portal for the mage's group. The portal's destination varies depending on what phase the user has Darkshore set to. If Darkshore is in its phase, the portal goes to the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus; if Darkshore is in its phase, the user will find themselves on Mist's Edge in Darkshore, looking across the water at Teldrassil's burnt remains. The phase can be changed by speaking to Zidormi, who's located south of Lor'danel.

Portal To The Unknown is an anima power available from the Experimental Anima Cell toy. Selecting this power creates a Portal to Someplace which, when interacted with, transports the player to one of a number of destinations.
Power Word: Fortitude is a priest ability, available at level 6. It increases the target's stamina by 5%. .]]

Powerful Anti-Venom is created with First Aid (300); taught by Formula: Powerful Anti-Venom, an Argent Dawn reputation reward.
Powershifting is the act of switching out of and quickly or instantly back into a Druid shapeshift form such as Cat Form, Bear Form, or Moonkin Form for various benefits.
The Power Amplification Goggles are crafted with Engineering (340); taught by Schematic: Power Amplification Goggles.

Power Core Fragment are devices near Beezil's Wreck in Dustwallow Marsh. If an Ooze Buster is in your inventory these objects will shoot energy at you, making you Energized! The device will allow you to destroy the nearby oozes for the quest Corrosion Prevention.

Powerful Ghostly Spellthread is created by Cataclysm Tailoring (75); taught by Pattern: Powerful Ghostly Spellthread.
Powerful Enchanted Spellthread is created by Cataclysm Tailoring (75); taught by Pattern: Powerful Enchanted Spellthread.

Potion of Deepholm teleports the player to Temple of Earth in Deepholm when consumed, within walking distance of the portals to Stormwind and Orgrimmar, and is usable by all players level 31 or above, regardless of Alchemy level or lack thereof. Its low cooldown (5 minutes, and shared with all potions) and availability on the Auction House makes it a convenient way to return to a faction capital when the Hearthstone is unavailable.
Powershot is a talented hunter ability, available at level 90.
Powerball is an ability used by armadillos, raccoons, hedgehogs, turtles and dragon turtles during a Pet Battle.
Power of the Grave is a passive blood death knight ability, available at level 80.
__NOTOC__ Powerful Burnished Cloak is created with Leatherworking (1); Taught by Pattern: Powerful Burnished Cloak.
Power Word: Radiance is a Discipline priest Power Word talent.

Powerful Mana Gems are looted from the objects of the same name in Alodi's Bank Vault in Dalaran during Alodi's Gems. In older times, when magic was less understood and spells required vast amounts of mana to cast, these gems were used to store mana for use in complex spells.
Power of Goldrinn is a Balance druid artifact trait. It is linked to the Touch of the Moon trait.
Potion of Prolonged Power is crafted with Alchemy (1); taught by Recipe: Potion of Prolonged Power.
Power of a Thousand Cranes is a Windwalker monk artifact trait. It is linked to the Dark Skies, Good Karma (artifact trait), and Strength of Xuen traits.
The Powerful Hexweave Cloak is created with Draenor Tailoring (100); taught by Pattern: Powerful Hexweave Cloak.
The Powerpack Blueprints are located near the Malfunctioning Beastbot in Bondo's Yard on Mechagon Island.
Power Coils are machines located in Rustbolt on Mechagon Island.
Powercore Schematics is obtained from Bondo Bigblock on Mechagon Island.
Powered Piscine Procurement Pole drops from Deepwater Maw on Mechagon Island.
Power of the Moon is an Azerite trait available to Balance druids. __NOTOC__
Power Pole are located in the Heaps on Mechagon Island. They are used to connect a variety of wires and pylons.
Power Coil Minis are mechanicals located in Rustbolt on Mechagon Island.
Potion of Empowered Proximity are created with Battle for Azeroth Alchemy (145); taught by Narv/Instructor Okanu and Recipe: Potion of Empowered Proximity.
Powered Security Modules can be obtained from Deactivated Security Modules at the Midnight Court in Suramar City.

Power Sources are pylons located throughout Valdrakken, while the Arcane Forge is being empowered. Clicking on one will place an orb of energy over the player's head and significantly reduce their movement speed; they must throw it to another player in order to get it to the Arcane Forge. It is worth 1 unit of Energy.
Preparation is a rogue ability. It finishes the cooldown of your other abilities when activated.

While mages, paladins, rogues, and warriors attract much of the spotlight on Azeroth, many heroes choose to follow more dedicated, specific paths to power and renown (or infamy, as the case may be). Through organizations, old traditions and esoteric ways, PCs can discover and gain levels in prestige classes, which specialize in particular abilities, skills, and areas of expertise. Note: The concept of prestige class is more of a game mechanic than having anything to do with lore. Due to changes in gameplay between the Warcraft RPG, and World of Warcraft RPG some prestige classes have been altered, updated, replaced, sometimes eliminated in the new series in order to make the game playable wi

Death knights use Presences, self-only buffs that work much like warriors' or monks' stances or hunters' aspects. Each Presence brings its own benefits and is suitable in a different situation. While their names correspond to the three death knight specializations, there is no direct link beyond this and the Presences have no effect on what abilities can be used at a given time. However, each specialization grants a passive improving their respective Presence (see below). There is no cost for shifting between Presences, but doing so will cause any stored Runic Power to be lost (unless Glyph of Shifting Presences is chosen). Presences have no duration, and a death knight will remain in their

The Prepfoot Compound is a small Highmountain tauren village nestled in the seaside cliffs in northeastern Highmountain. It is the main base for the Prepfoot, a group of tauren who believe that Deathwing will soon return and that the end of the world is imminent. A small storehouse where the Prepfoot store their supplies is found at the southeastern end of the compound. Below the eastern side of the village, there is a small lake with a graveyard on the eastern end.

Priestess A'moora is a night elf quest giver located in the Oracle Glade on Teldrassil. Before the Cataclysm, she was located in The Temple of the Moon in Darnassus. During the Burning of Teldrassil, she was seen healing Desperate Darnassian Citizens in the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus. It is unknown whether she survived the Burning of Teldrassil or not.

__NOTOC__ The Pridewing Patriarch was a rare mob wyvern found in the mountains east or south of Mirkfallon Lake in Stonetalon Mountains. He was on a 4-6 hour respawn timer. He has since returned from hiding and his level scales with that of players. Only this time, he is forest green instead of gold. To obtain him, hunters with the secrets of taming Feathermanes must defeat a set number of pridewings in Windshear Heights.

icon.]] Primals are those warriors who revel in their bestial rage and give into it completely. As they slowly take on an increasingly beast-like appearance, they also gain powerful and violent abilities. Primals believe that every creature is inhabited by a dark, primeval essence. They hold to the notion that each and every living soul is haunted by a beastly force, and that those who accept this fact can eventually ascend to another level of existence - one that is more primitive, but also more connected to nature and the animal kingdom. Though very few can fathom the existence of this whimsical force, primeval characters strive to unlock its secrets. They call this pristine essence "the b

Primal Tenacity is a talent in the Feral Combat tree, you will need to spend 33 points in Feral Combat to max it. Because it reduces the duration of crowd control abilities, this talent is generally considered a PvP talent.

The Primal Guardians were three spirits of ancient protectors that guarded the Horn of Cenarius on Moonglade Isle in Moonglade after the demigod's death during the Third War. They were aided by several owlbears. Tyrande Whisperwind defeated them in order to reach the Horn to awaken Malfurion Stormrage and the other druids. They each had the class "Ancient Guardian."
Prince Raze is a rare mob satyr found in Xavian in Ashenvale. He is on a 5-8 hour respawn timer. His most powerful ability is his Charged Arcane Bolt which can easily kill a player.

Prince Toreth is a night elf ghost quest giver located on Wyrmscar Island on Bloodmyst Isle. Some time around the War of the Ancients, Toreth was the prince of what would eventually come to be known as Bloodmyst Isle, and a member of the Dragon Riders of Loreth'Aran, a group of night elves allowed to ride upon Ysera's brood. When Deathwing's brood slaughtered the Dragon Riders, Toreth was the last to fall. As he died, he swore a blood oath to never let the story of the Dragon Riders be lost to the mists of time. Because of his oath, his spirit is bound to Wyrmscar Island off the coast of Bloodmyst, where he tells any who ask about the glories of his people and the fate that befell them.

Prince Nadun is the brother of King Phaoris of Ramkahen and is first encountered by players within a phased version of the Lost City of the Tol'vir during the initial quests for Uldum. He is a quest giver and players assist in helping him escape his Neferset jailers. He was betrayed by his closest allies while investigating a new, powerful ally of the Neferset; the traitors then joined the Neferset officially. He can later be found at both Ramkahen and Mar'at in Uldum. Nadun believes that war with Neferset, the stone-skinned tol'vir allied with Deathwing and Al'Akir, is ultimately necessary, while Phaoris hopes to avert it. During the vote of the Ramkahen High Council in The High Council's D

Prince Sarsarun is one of the four Elemental Unrest bosses unlocked upon the successful defense of Stormwind or Thunder Bluff. He can be found inside the Ruins of Ahn'Qiraj, accessed either via the Dungeon Finder or the wind portals upon the conclusion of the invasion. He is available for 30 minutes every three hours if the city defense was successful. Unlike other Elemental Unrest bosses, Prince Sarsarun is not a more powerful version of a boss encountered in his dungeon. His model is identical to Prince Thunderaan, though he wields a different weapon. The Sarsarun encounter is also unique in that it takes place in Ahn'Qiraj Terrace, a special subzone of Ruins of Ahn'Qiraj used only in this

__NOTOC__ Prince Lakma is a rare chimaera has been seen flying in the southwestern parts of Feralas across from the sunken Isle of Dread. This island was the only source of Chimaerok Tenderloins until the isle sank beneath the waves during the Cataclysm.

Primitive Roggtotem is a potential reward from the following Class Hall missions: * Critical Crops (mission) * Evergreen * Hazardous Materials * Feltotem Hounds * The Pale Predator * Hide as White as Snow * The Mountain Stirs * Smashing Faces * Munitions Testing (mission) * Plagued Bears It is also a quest reward from normal Highmountain world quests and can be found inside Curious Wyrmtongue Cache.
Prince Oceanus is a sea giant found in Oceanus Cove in Azsuna. The gladiators of Shipwreck Arena rebelled and with the help of adventurers killed the prince. He is the son of King Deepbeard.

__NOTOC__ Primordial Drakes are red proto-dragons found in the Savage Thicket in Sholazar Basin. They can be found both flying in the air and walking on the ground. Those on the ground will occasionally use the Birthing Flames ability to incubate one of the Primordial Drake Eggs scattered across the thicket, causing a Primordial Hatchling to emerge. Their queen is Broodmother Slivina.

__NOTOC__ Primordial Wave is the shaman class ability of the Necrolord Covenant. It's available to all shaman who join the Necrolords. This ability is also temporarily available during the Maldraxxus portion of the Shadowlands campaign; it's given by the quest Champion the Cause and lasts until you finish the Maldraxxus storyline.

The Primalists are the followers of the Primal Incarnates, ancient proto-dragons that chose to side against the titans and the Dragon Aspects. They recruit people by offering them elemental powers. The Primalists have been known to reshape the land, whether by lava or by ice, like at the Flashfrost Enclave. They also steal dragon and proto-dragon eggs in order to infuse them with elemental energies and turn them to their side. They have also been known to transform furbolgs by giving them bodies of hardened stone. Besides their hatred for the titans and their dragon loyalists, they also oppose the Kirin Tor, thinking they deserve death for using arcane magic. The dragonspawn and drakonid who
__NOTOC__ Profane Bloodspeakers are blood trolls who appear briefly at Antul'Mita Plateau in Nazmir. They can be seen using blood magic on dead direhorns.

Prospecting is a jewelcrafting ability used to process raw ore in order to find gems. This ability is available to all jewelcrafters regardless of skill level. Prospecting an ore from an expansion does not require that expansion's jewelcrafting proficiency; for example, Osmenite Ore can be prospected without learning Kul Tiran or Zandalari Jewelcrafting first. Various mass prospecting skills can be learned from trainers, but those do require a certain skill level in the relevant expansion proficiency. Each prospecting attempt consumes 5 ore of the same type and is guaranteed to yield at least one item. Mass prospecting consumes 20 ore of the same type at once, and multiple mass prospecting a

The Professions tab is found on the Spellbook & Abilities interface. It gives quick and easy access to the character's current primary professions, as well as all secondary professions. Abilities and skill levels for all currently trained professions are found here, along with links to the profession crafting interfaces themselves. All secondary professions are listed, whether or not the player has learned them. Players can also unlearn profession specializations here.

Professor Putricide's Lost Journal is part of the unholy death knight quest to gain The Bonereaper's Hook, a hidden appearance for Apocalypse. Using the Apocalypse (death knight ability) ability has a chance to spawn an additional ghoul, which speaks when it spawns: : ... and drops Putricide's journal on the ground when it expires.

A type of ranged distance that determines the distance an effect will work at, but doesn't require line of sight or front-facing like most effects. Generally, the target must be selected and within range. Nearly all ranged weapons are NOT proximity-based, but most buff or debuff abilities, powers, or spells can affect merely within given proximity to the caster.
:"Your father dabbled in powers "beyond reckoning". Where is he... now?" — Taran Zhu Provoke is a monk ability.
Provisioner Keayonni is a Highmountain tauren general goods vendor found at the Summitcrest Basecamp in Highmountain.
The Proudmoore Barracks is the main barracks for the city of Boralus, attached to Proudmoore Keep via a bridge. It is on the edge of the city, between Hook Point and Hatherford.
Protoform Barriers are orbs that spawn from a raid boss that has the Fated Power: Protoform Barrier. Destroying them will grant all raid members .

Purge is a shaman class talent that removes a "Magic" buff effect from one enemy target. It is similar to a priest's Dispel Magic. The spell will also be cast if a target is immune through some mechanism such as Ice Block or Banish. It is an exclusive choice node with Greater Purge.

Purgation Isle is an island south of the shores of Hillsbrad Foothills, in a shape of a towering spiral. It contains a cemetery and a ruined scout tower. Once haunted by ghosts unable to find peace in death, the island serves as a base of operations for the Stormpike clan and the Bloodfang pack in the region since the Cataclysm.

Purchase refers to buying an item from a vendor (or from a player via the Auction House) as opposed to looting it or receiving it as a quest reward. A purchaseable item is almost always BOE (or just not soulbound) and are generally easier to obtain than loot or quest rewards. A recepie for a profession, for example, is generally easier to find if it can be bought. The downside is that purchaseable items are generally less powerful (an extreme case being end-game armor/weapons) than BOP items due to their wide avaiability.
Purify Spirit is a Restoration shaman ability that removes all Magic effects from a friendly target.

icon.]] Orcs burn their dead. In a world filled with magic, magic insinuates itself in ritual. Founded in the mysteries of certain cults on Draenor, the pyremaster is the enactor of ritual. This funerary priest guides the dead through fire, through loss of flesh, so their naked spirits may conquer the elements; in order to protect his duties (and his person), he commands both bone and fire. Orc pyremasters are scattered across Azeroth. Places where fire and heat are dominant (particularly in the Burning Steppes and the Searing Gorge) are cult strongholds. Orcs are the only pyremasters, though it is conceivable that orcs could teach the class's secrets to others. They are independent or are m
Pygmy Brutes are level 85 pygmies found in Lost City of the Tol'vir. =Abilities= * *
Pygmy Scouts are level 83-85 pygmies found in Uldum and the Lost City of the Tol'vir. =Abilities= *
The Pyrestar Demolisher is a powerful Arcane golem created by the Sunreaver Onslaught to protect the Dawnseeker Promontory.

:"If you strike her down, she shall become more powerful than you can possibly… well, she'll become a 6/6 anyways." :— Flavor text Pyros is a phoenix native to Un'Goro Crater in the Journey to Un'Goro expansion for Hearthstone. The first two times she dies, she returns to the player's hand as a more powerful version.
The Pyramid is located on the table behind Griftah in the market of the Lower City in Shattrath City. It can be interacted with if the Talisman of True Treasure Tracking is worn.

Quel'Delar's Rest is located in Icecrown and is north of Silent Vigil. It is ringed by small lantern stands, and a sword, Quel'Delar is stuck in the ice where there seems to be a dragon's skull underneath. It can be used as a landmark to help find the Argent Tournament Grounds since the road is directly north of the site. During 3.3.0 the San'layn matriach Blood-Queen Lana'thel appears at the site and begins a long conversation of the swords history and defiles it so its magical powers may never be used against her or the Scourge.

Quaking Palm is an active pandaren racial ability that puts a target to sleep for 4 seconds, and switches off the player's melee auto-attack. For the duration, the target will be unable to take any actions, except to use counters such as PvP trinkets. However, any damage taken will break the effect. The ability is useful as a form of crowd control, to allow the player to focus on another target, to interrupt the current target, or simply to buy a few moments in which to heal, or escape.

Quelen was a Guardian of Azeroth who researched the . He was unusual in that he involved 's caretaker, in every aspect of his work. According to the castellan, the fel destroyed Quelen because it made him paranoid and insecure. Moroes admitted that his love for Quelen made him hesitant to admit that Quelen didn't possess the strength of will that has. As such, he gave Medivh Quelen's journal and the new Guardian continued the research. Given the fact there's new Guardian, he is very likely deceased.

The Queen's Conservatory in Ardenweald is a celestial garden which can be accessed only to members of the Night Fae Covenant, here Night Fae will harness the power of rebirth that flows through Ardenweald to help the souls of ancient deities to return to life. It was a rarely used grove for Wild Gods who were wounded upon their demise, and needed special care before being reborn, but its survival is critical to the cycle. During adventures in the Shadowlands, adventurers will come across the preserved souls of celestial spirits from across the cosmos. Within the Queen’s Conservatory adventurers will find the power to aid in restoring those souls to their former glory. To restore souls advent

Quilboar (also spelled quillboar and sometimes pluralized as quilboars) are a race of aggressive, primitive boar-like humanoids native to Kalimdor, Kul Tiras and the Exile's Reach island. They have razor sharp spines protruding from their muscular, hunched backs. These resilient, fearless creatures inhabit the central Barrens of Kalimdor in the labyrinthine maze of thorns called Razorfen Downs. Among them, the quilboar brutes are larger and more powerful male quilboar changed by a special ritual.

__NOTOC__ Quintis Jonespyre was a night elf quest giver located in Feathermoon Stronghold in Feralas. He was a researcher — curses were his specialty. He was concerned with why Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm in Darnassus was using the name of the Cenarion Circle, as well as the Circle's resources, to procure vast amounts of morrowgrain. Quintis had heard that morrowgrain, under the right conditions, exuded qualities like other herbs used in primitive curses. He and Shandris Feathermoon had had long conversations about Staghelm, and both had futilely hoped that Tyrande Whisperwind would formally reprimand Staghelm for his strange activities, but the high priestess had only reminded them th
__NOTOC__ Quithas is a blood elf mage trainer located in Sunfury Spire in Silvermoon City. He was present in the Court of the Sun during the closing of the remembrance ceremony.

RAWRbomb is the name of the technique which allows a druid in flight form to quickly descend and attack a target. In mid-air she shifts out of Flight Form, then (while falling toward the enemy) shifts into bear or cat form and Feral Charges. This brings the falling Druid toward the enemy, and when properly executed, the druid takes no falling damage.

Quilen (pronounced "kwai-lin") are canine-leonine creatures that are native to Pandaria and serve as the favorite companions of the mogu. Mogu sorcerers create them by breathing life into stone using an ancient, secret magic. Loyal and fearless, these stone hounds know no mercy and can be quite skilled at blending into their surroundings. The mogu use them as guard dogs, in war, and to track their enemies. There are three variations of quilen: organic, stone, and adorned stone. During the brief reign of Emperor Kang, the mogu experimented with binding quilen servants in small stone statuettes. The experiment was abandoned as the quilen thus bound were greatly diminished in power and therefor

Highkeeper Ra was a titanic watcher who was originally charged to watch over the southern regions of Azeroth that would later be known as Pandaria, Uldum and Ahn'Qiraj. Ra bestowed life on the mogu, who know him as Ra-den or Ra-Den, which means "Master Ra" in their tongue. The Highkeeper has also simply been referred to by the mogu as The Storm and later "the sleeping keeper", while Xuen has referred to him as "the storm lord" or even "the storm god". Thousands of years ago, Ra was defeated by , who stole the keeper's power and used it to establish his empire. Ra was thereafter chained beneath the Throne of Thunder, the seat of Lei Shen's power until he was ultimately freed by mortal adventu

__NOTOC__ Quizla Blastcaps is a goblin located in Tiragarde Sound, Searat's Volitile Valuables in the Terrace of Crafters in Dazar'alor, and on Mechagon Island. She and Shuga grew up in Kezan. She now wears a Laughing Skull clan mask because she thinks she is a member of the clan after meeting with Kil'rip. This seems to irritate Uraka Wildthunder, which she worked with. She then traveled to Mechagon Island. She can be seen in Rustbolt throwing bombs at a Rustbolt Spraybot. She can be seen in the Drag in Orgrimmar. She joins up with the Dragonscale Expedition and can be found at Wingrest Embassy in the Waking Shores.
RSVP: Lady Moonberry is a quest reward from For Your Consideration: Lady Moonberry.
Quinton Flynn is a voice actor who has provided several voices for Warcraft universe.

.]] A rabbit is a small, fluffy critter that can be found in almost all grassy or forested areas of Azeroth. It is a favorite target of predators. The squashed carcasses of these unfortunate animals are often found within the folds of the skin of various thunder lizards around Durotar. When you have two rabbits, you'll often soon have three. Spring rabbits symbolize fertility, and they love to demonstrate why. Despite their idyllic surroundings, grasslands cottontails hop at surprising speed when evading their pursuers. Mountain cottontails can leap up a steep incline with speed you would not believe. The elfin rabbits' proximity to the magic of the elves has caused some of them unnatural lo

Racial traits, commonly referred to as racials, are special abilities or powers granted to a player character based on race. These traits come in both active and passive forms. Each race has at least 3 traits (several passive and at least one active trait per race) known by all characters of that race at the time of creation. Racials represent the main gameplay difference between races, and aside from faction choice, the main non-cosmetic basis to choose between races.

__NOTOC__ Rachelle Gothena is a Forsaken candy vendor located in the Valley of Strength in the orcish city of Orgrimmar. Other than selling candy, she also gives information about Hallow's End and what can be done during this event.

Ragefeather Ridge is a hilly region of northeastern Bloodmyst Isle filled with tainted moonkin camps. All the moonkin have become hostile due to crystal radiation from the Exodars fallen crystalline shards.

__NOTOC__ Rachel DeSimone is a Gilnean woman that can be found talking with Jamie Harriott, Carrie Eileen Steen and Jenn Stravaganza inside the Howling Oak, in the night elven city of Darnassus. During the Burning of Teldrassil, she was seemingly evacuated with the civilians to Stormwind City.

Radiant (previously Holyfire) refers to a type of magic school which combines Holy and Fire. Multi-school abilities benefit from bonuses that affect any of their schools, use the lowest resistance value among their schools, ignore absorption and immunity effects that apply to only some of their schools, and can be used even when one or more of their schools have been locked with an interrupt effect.

The Racing Pengling is a penguin located atop the north-easternmost mountain in Tiragarde Sound. Interact with the penguin for a ride down the mountain. While riding, Speeding Yetis may appear and give chase.

Radiant Spark is the mage class ability of the Kyrian Covenant. It's available to all mages who join the Kyrian. This ability is also temporarily available during the Bastion portion of the Shadowlands campaign; it's given by the quest The Archon's Answer and lasts until you finish the Bastion storyline.
Raiden was a pandaren geomancer. He created caps called the Cap of Raiden, which offered resistance to electricity, and could store power to shock enemies.

Raise Ally is a death knight ability that returns a fallen raid or party member back to life. This is basically a Resurrection ability usable in combat, similar to a druid's Rebirth. Players resurrected by this spell receive the Void-Touched debuff, which makes them semi-transparent and gives them a shadowy aura.
Rain from Above is a demon hunter PvP talent. It causes the demon hunter to fly into the air and gain access to the bonus ability Fel Lance via a temporary vehicle bar.
Raidmaster Sorthol was a doomguard who let an attack on the Highmountain tauren in Highmountain. He was killed when the Knights of the Silver Hand arrived to establish a trade route with the tauren.

__NOTOC__ Ralara was one of the Highborne magi dispatched by Malfurion Stormrage to Ashenvale in an effort to aid Commander Delaryn Summermoon in defending the night elves' lands against the massive Horde invasion led by Sylvanas Windrunner in the War of the Thorns. Despite helping to burn the bridges spanning the Falfarren River under Delaryn's orders in an attempt to slow the invasion, she and the other Highborne were all targeted and killed by the Forsaken dark rangers and possibly their Warchief herself later on in the conflict. Following her death, her body was encountered by the Horde in their quest to resurrect Delaryn Summermoon as a Forsaken.

Raleigh refers to multiple things, which one do you mean? ;NPCs * Raleigh the Devout - Located in Southshore, formerly known as Raleigh the True. * Raleigh Andrean - Located in the Undercity. * Raleigh Puule - located in Frostfire Ridge ;Quests *Raleigh and the Undercity

Rapid Fire is a hunter ability that gives the hunter increased ranged attack speed. It also reduces the "casting" time of Steady Shot and Cobra Shot. By allowing you to shoot faster, it significantly increases the damage you can do for a short period of time, and effective use of the ability is central to hunter DPS in groups.

. (Removed)]] Ranazjar Isle is a small, rocky island off the northwest coast of Desolace. It was inhabited by the serpentine naga, but now they lie slaughtered on the ground by Lord Hydronis. On the isle, there are night elven ruins that seem to be part of the same ancient city as those of Ethel Rethor.
Randolph Montague is a Forsaken banker located in the Trade Quarter in the Undercity. He was present during the Battle for Lordaeron and could be evacuated out of the Undercity.

Ralston Farnsley is a Forsaken quest giver located at the Dranosh'ar Blockade in Durotar during the preparation for the Horde assault on the Broken Shore. He was previously located in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity prior to Cataclysm.

__NOTOC__ Ranger Jaela is a blood elf quest giver located at the northernmost part of the Dead Scar in Eversong Woods. She and her rangers are defending the walls of Silvermoon City from constant attacks of Rotlimb Cannibals.

The Random Secondary Target System (RSTS) is a system deployed by Blizzard to make certain encounters harder and more challenging. The system will target someone in a party or raid but the target is never the player who is highest on the aggro list. The system is probably designed to make the encounters more dynamic, otherwise most of the encounters would be "normal" Tank and Spank. Common abilities using Random Secondary Target System: * Heavy Damage spells, most of the time not enough to kill a victim but enough to require attention from the healers. * Other spells, like silence, DoTs, and alike. * Charges, the mob/boss randomly charge players with various abilities after the charge rangin

is the maximum distance at which an ability, attack, power, or spell has an effect. Ranged weapon attacks have a range of 40 yards for hunters and 30 yards for all other classes. Effects that don't require direct contact are called ranged effects, as opposed to melee effects.

The unique title of Ranger-General (also known as the Ranger-General of Silvermoon, Ranger General of Quel'Thalas, or Ranger-General of the Farstriders, all occasionally written in lower case and with or without hyphen) is given to the commander of the Farstriders — the elite group of blood elf rangers of Quel'Thalas. The ranger-general is also the commander of all of Quel'Thalas' military forces, and is in charge of Silvermoon's defenses. The current Ranger-General following Sylvanas Windrunner's death is Halduron Brightwing.

Randy Whizzlesprocket was a gnome who appeared at the entrance to the Sewer in Shattered Halls. He was injured, and gave players a quest to rescue Captain Alina, who was being held prisoner by Warchief Kargath Bladefist. He only appeared to Alliance players when Shattered Halls was played in Heroic mode.
The Rangers' Lodge is the headquarters of the Farstriders inside Farstriders' Square of Silvermoon City.

The Rangari, also called the "Eyes of the Prophet", are a group of draenei scouts and rangers who silently stalk the farthest corners of . Their role in draenei society is mostly to gather valuable intelligence about the lay of the land, in order to use it for their advantage. The organization is led by . One of their enclaves is located in the city of Elodor in . In the main universe the Rangari survived the genocide of the draenei and are still active on Azeroth. It is unknown if Naielle still leads them or not.

Ransa Greyfeather is the emissary and quartermaster for the Highmountain Tribe, found on the upper level of Thunder Totem in Highmountain. She can later be found at the Port of Zandalar in Dazar'alor as the emissary for the Honorbound.

.]] Ranishu are small humanoid bug creatures found in Vol'dun. They travel by rolling up into balls and devour anything in sight with no regard for taste or texture. Rozzy describes them as ravenous whirlwinds of devouring destruction. When they get going, they consume anything in their path without even stopping. When sated, they discharge electricity from their antennae and then nap. Gulch beetles are their preferred foodsource, but in practice they'll eat anything. Ranishu have multiple stomachs, and their stomach acid makes potent poison. Their antennae are great conductors for magic. When they have access to a large amount of food, ranishu can rapidly reproduce and escalate into a deadl

A rare mob is a special mob or monster. However, the exact details of what comprises a rare mob vary according to the expansion (or even patch) in which the mob was introduced. Rare mobs may possess one or more of the following qualities: possessing far more health and more powerful abilities than regular mobs; spawning less frequently; dropping special loot; being recorded in special achievements; and representing a substantial challenge for players to defeat. Like elite mobs, rare mobs have a dragon around their portrait; however, unlike elites, this dragon icon is silver and lacks a wing on the side. They can also be elite, in which case the wing is present. Rare mobs are frequently misca
Rapid Recuperation is a passive specialization ability for Marksmanship hunters, available at level 46. It causes you to regenerate focus every time you use Rapid Fire (Classic).

Rashar is a large, purple lion found inside a small cave in the northwestern part of Pinerock Basin in Highmountain. Ellias once encountered the magical beast and found himself entranced by its amber eyes; only when Rashar pounced on him did the stupor break. When Ellias told Hemet Nesingwary of the encounter, Hemet simply laughed, and so Ellias sends adventurers to kill Rashar and take the beast's eye in order to prove its existence to Hemet.

The Ravenous flayers are a pack of rock flayers settled on the Shattered Plains in northern Shadowmoon Valley. With little amount of creatures to feed upon in the area, they have taken to feeding on Oronok Torn-heart's livestock.

The Ravenous Fly is a bait item that is looted from flies attracted to Decayed Whale Blubber. The fly enables one to catch Ancient Black Barracuda. If this item is used after having obtained the Underlight Angler, one will instead be able to catch Ancient Black Barracuda.

__NOTOC__ Ravenian is a black dragon who appears during the Island Expeditions. Like other "event bosses," he has a chance to spawn in multiple different islands. He shares spawns with fellow black dragons Tyrantion and Stygia.
Ravishing Betrayers are sayaad located in the Undercity during the Battle for the Undercity.

Ravenous Frenzy is the druid class ability of the Venthyr Covenant. It's available to all druids who join the Venthyr. This ability is also temporarily available during the Revendreth portion of the Shadowlands campaign; it's given by the quest The Authority of Revendreth and lasts until you finish the Revendreth storyline.

A reagent is an item that is required in order to use a specific spell or ability. Reagents differ from tools in that reagents are consumed when their spell or ability is successfully cast, while tools are not. Most reagents are purchasable from reagent vendors, who can be found in all major cities and many towns.

When players come across Dream Dust in the Swamp, they may be faced with a dilemma: where is the Swamp of Sorrows, and more importantly, how in the world do you get there? This is much simpler for Alliance players who can simply run through Darkshire to Deadwind Pass, but has proven difficult for Horde characters who do not have the flight point. If you are Horde, and have the FP, simply fly to Stonard. If not, read on.

Razz Wheeler is a half-drunk gnome who drowns his sorrows at a bar at the Mirage Raceway. He became down on his luck when his hand was permanently injured in an explosion. He cannot work and he lost the last of his money betting on a race. He wishes to move to a major city, or have his hand restored with magic. He has a sample of super rocket fuel and he would be willing to part with it if anyone could help him out.

The Razorfin are a tribe and a clan of jinyu located on the Rotting Mire. They are unique amongst jinyu. Long ago the elder of the tribe was granted a vision of a great beast. So terrified was he that he named it "Onoho," or "Deep Shadow." He dedicated his tribe to slaying the beast. They travel from island to island, never staying for long, in their endless quest.

Reaver's Fall is a small Horde settlement between the Legion Front and Thrallmar. Forward Commander To'arch assigns tasks to Horde adventurers who report there. Supply Officer Isabel does equipment repair. The encampment takes its name from the fact that it is constructed from the remains of a destroyed fel reaver. This is the location where Horde members can complete "bombing runs" on the back of a flying mount in order to disrupt the forces of the Burning Legion.
Rebel Drogbar are drogbar located in Highmountain. They are visions of the past, seen assisting Huln Highmountain defeat the Deathwing in Neltharion's Vault.
Recipe: Battle Potion of Strength teaches alchemists to make Battle Potion of Strength. Rank 3 has the chance to produce multiple items.
The Recipe: Elixir of Major Firepower is a reputation reward; you must be Revered with The Scryers to purchase it for from in Shattrath City.
The Recipe: Flask of Supreme Power teaches you to make a Flask of Supreme Power.
The Recipe: Elixir of Shadow Power can be purchased for from: * in Tirisfal Glades * in Stormwind City
The Recipe: Lemon Herb Filet is sold by Galissa Sundew in Darkmoon Island for .
Recipe: Darkmoon Card of the Legion is a spell effect that teaches a scribe how to craft a Darkmoon Card of the Legion.
Recipe: Endless Tincture of Fractional Power teaches alchemists to make Endless Tincture of Fractional Power. Rank 3 has the chance to produce multiple tinctures.
Recipe: Cowardly Flight Potion has been present in the game data since vanilla World of Warcraft, but was never implemented. It would have taught the recipe for Cowardly Flight Potion.
The Recipe: Extra Lemony Herb Filet is sold by Galissa Sundew in Darkmoon Island for .
Recipe: Extra Sugary Fish Feast is sold by Galissa Sundew in Darkmoon Island for .
Recipe: Potion Cauldron of Ultimate Power was never made available. The recipe is instead taught by Elemental Codex of Ultimate Power.
Reconnaissance Flight is a quick quest that sends players up to the Avalanche and back to River's Heart in Sholazar Basin on Vic's Flying Machine.
Recipe: Superior Battle Potion of Strength teaches Superior Battle Potion of Strength. It has a chance to drop from naga in Nazjatar.
Reconfiguration Emitters are orbs that spawn from a raid boss that has the Fated Power: Reconfiguration Emitter: : Destroying them will grant all raid members .

Red dragons are dragons that have red scales and breath fire that gives both life and death. Their fire can either destroy or bring life. They are led by Alexstrasza the Life-Binder; with most of their race being part of the eponymous red dragonflight. The titan Eonar charged Alexstrasza with protecting life. The red dragons generally wish to protect all life on Azeroth as their queen does, while battling those who wish to do the world harm. In particular, the black dragons and their twilight aberrations served as the red dragon's foremost enemies. Despite their mission, some red dragons hold a mistrust, even animosity, towards mortals because of the events of the Second War. Many red dragon
A Red Power Crystal is a type of power crystal that can be found throughout Terror Run in Un'Goro Crater.

Redridge Canyons, or Red Ridge Canyons, form a labyrinthine network of passages nestled in the northwestern section of the Redridge Mountains. Although it used to be a favored spot for hunting deer and mountain boar by the local populace, it has been claimed by a tribe of gnolls who are led by the ferocious Yowler, and it is no longer a safe place to venture.
The Red Dragonhawk is a swift flying mount rewarded from the Mountain o' Mounts achievement. You need to obtain 100 mounts.

before Detonation]] after Detonation]] Redridge Mountains is an Alliance-only level 15-20 zone in central Azeroth on the Eastern Kingdoms. Players are led here at the conclusion of the Westfall storyline. The progress of the storyline is tracked in the achievement Redridge Mountains Quests. Upon the conclusion of the Redridge storyline, Bailiff Conacher opens up Hero's Call: Duskwood!, starting the Duskwood storyline. (pre-Cataclysm storyline)

Redridge Pass is a long road running through the easternmost section of the Redridge Mountains that stretches from Terror Wing Path in the Burning Steppes to Bogpaddle in the Swamp of Sorrows. It is not accessible on foot from the lower portion of Redridge. The Steamwheedle Cartel offers a fast mode of transportation along the Pass via the Bogpaddle Bullet, a rocket that zips from the northern end in Burning Steppes to the south, stopping at their resort town of Bogpaddle. There is no similar transport heading north -- players will have to go on foot (or take a flight).

Redridge Citizens are the unnamed citizens of Lakeshire in Redridge Mountains. A number of them can be found in the basement of the Lakeshire Inn where they watch the fights that take place there. The initial fight is between and . However, many citizens have become fed up with 's inability to deal with the problems that plague their town. They can be found lined up out the door in the town hall. After Triumphant Return, they are no longer present. The s they are complaining about have recently been abducted by the Blackrock orcs, though the disappearances were blamed on the gnolls. They are held in Render's Valley until the adventurer rescues them.

Red Skymane is a Highmountain tauren found inside a hut in Snowmane Village in Highmountain along with her pet fox, Kaya. She needs to be evacuated for Evacuate Snowmane, but before leaving she picks up Kaya in order to carry her to safety.
Red Dragonflight Recruiter is a red drakonid located in the Quad in Algeth'ar Academy. She is accompanied by three Red Dragonflight Alumni.
Red Dragonflight Alumni is a red drakonid and a pair of red dragonspawn located near Red Dragonflight Recruiter in the Quad in Algeth'ar Academy.

Refugee Caravan is a small neutral makeshift camp in the northern part of the Bone Wastes in Terokkar Forest. It is populated by several refugees of numerous races who are living in Shattrath City. They were going to assault Auchindoun but were attacked by Shadow Council raiders before they arrived. Caravan Defenders and Sha'tar Vindicators protect the refugees and people who are diligently working to repair wagons to get the caravan back to the city. There were a number of children who have been kidnapped and brought to Veil Skith, a Skettis village. Ethan, a small boy, asks passersbyers to rescue his friends. There are also other people with various quests to offer. The vindicators and def

Reinforce was a guild perk that decreases the durability loss of your gear upon death. Rank 1, available at guild level 7, causes 10% less durability damage. Rank 2, at guild level 9, causes 20% less damage.
Reginald Grimsford is a Forsaken wandering around alongside Selina Pickman and Davitt Hickson in the Magic Quarter and the Trade Quarter of the Undercity.

__NOTOC__ Refugee Children are blood elf, draenei, human, and orc girls located in the Lower City in Shattrath. Most of them are located in and around the orphanage, where one of them coos over the orphanage's babies. Another group of three Refugee Children are standing in a tent in the northern part of the Lower City and periodically go on a walk west to the Skettis Outcasts' quarters before heading back; the trip partially overlaps with one taken by a trio of male Refugee Kids, whose behavior the girls make fun of.

Refugee Kids are blood elf, draenei, human, and orc boys located throughout the Lower City in Shattrath, mainly in and around the orphanage. One group of Refugee Kids run nonstop in a wide circle around the southern parts of the Lower City. Another group of three Refugee Kids stand outside the Shattrath Infirmary in the northern part and periodically go on a walk west to the Skettis Outcasts' quarters before heading back; the trip partially overlaps with one taken by a trio of female Refugee Children, who make fun of the boys for their behavior.
Regenerating Banana Bunch dropped from island expeditions. It provides a never-ending supply of Perfectly Ripe Bananas.
Regeneratin is a Zandalari troll racial ability that heals the caster for 100% of their maximum health over 6 seconds. It heals 17% of max health per second.
Regenerative Frame would start Abomination Part: Regenerative Frame.
Regenerative Fungus is a DPS-only anima power that can be chosen after defeating Oros Coldheart in Mythic+ dungeons with the Tormented affix.
Reflection Peak is a mountain peak just above Snowblind Mesa in Highmountain. The peak is where Ram'Pag, and the Totally Safe Treasure Chest is found.

The Reins of the Thundering August Cloud Serpent is an August Celestials reputation reward, sold for from at the Shrine of Seven Stars and at the Shrine of Two Moons in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms. It requires reputation to purchase.

__NOTOC__ Reins of the Thundering Onyx Cloud Serpent is looted from Huolon, a rare elite cloud serpent flying above the Blazing Way on Timeless Isle. Its spawn time is the same as many of the regular rares on the island. It also has a chance to be listed on the Black Market Auction House by Madam Goya, for the opening bid of .

__NOTOC__ The Remnant of Dahlia Suntouch is the freed spirit of Dahlia Suntouch, a high elf who voluntarily served Alexstrasza the Life-Binder and the Red dragonflight. For longer than she could remember, she was the keeper of the Ruby Dragonshrine and was given the Ruby Brooch as the insignia of her post. Her only regret is that when the Scourge overran the shrine, she failed in her mandate to protect it. The human death knight Orbaz Bloodbane killed her and raised her in undeath. As a banshee in service to the Scourge, she became a source of corruption for the shrine. Her spirit is freed from the banshee remains by adventurers. The Red flight think very highly of Dahlia, and when informed
"Remedial Magic 101: Tips from the Pros" is a book in Dalaran which can spawn in place of The Schools of Arcane Magic.
Relic of Xuen is a Darkmoon Card with two versions, Agility and Strength.

Remembery is a minigame that can be played on the Darkmoon Arcade Console at the Darkmoon Faire. When the game is launched, four by four shells, allowing for 8 pairs, appear on a piece of parchment. The shells hide objects that must be matched with their identical counterparts. The shells can be turned two at a time. There is no progression.

__NOTOC__ Relka Bloodfyre is the last Mag'har orc of the Shadowmoon clan. She appears in Razor Hill in Durotar during the Heritage of Draenor questline, having come to the Kosh'harg in the hopes of sharing her dead clan's magical knowledge with the Lok'osh, the Horde's recently-formed group of orc priests. She initially stands off by herself on the western outskirts of town, since her clan affiliation makes her a pariah. During the feast at the end of the festival, she moves to the center of town, sharing a table with the two magi Arcweaver Kashra and Marud.

Renato Gallina is a human quest giver located in the Trade District in Stormwind City. He is a member of the Gallina family, who own Gallina Winery along the Canals. He can be found in the main square of the Trade District, advertising the wine shop to passers-by which he claims "sells the best wine in Stormwind". He was present among the concerned citizens when the Veiled Hand and the Uncrowned infiltrated the city.

Render's Rock is a large cave in the northwestern Redridge Mountains near the entrance to the Burning Steppes. It contains a number of powerful Blackrock orcs. Render's Rock is also the location of the wounded Corporal Keeshan, who needs help in getting to Lakeshire in one piece.

If a player goes back into the cave containing the remnant, they can use the Heart of Azeroth of purify the roots, seemingly destroying them.
